content: प्लवन [प्लु-ल्युट्] {%a.%} Inclined, stooping down; प्रागुदक्प्लवनां भूमिं कारयेत् यत्नतो नरः <ls>Matsya P.</ls> .{@-नम्@} .²1 Swimming. .²2 Bathing, plunging into; आनन्दमन्दममृतप्लवनादिवाभूत् <ls>Māl. 1. 19</ls>. .²3 Flying. .²4 Jumping, leaping. .²5 A great flood, deluge. .²6 A declivity. .²7 One of a horseʼs paces (capering).
